## Provenance 

**Source Artifact:** 
- Chai3D - Bullet Demo Examples (06-Bullet-exploration)
- Chai3D (Framework), Bullet (Physics Engine), Novint Falcon (Haptics Device), C++

- **Original Behavior:** A simple demo, to showcase haptics and physics engine with a gripper cursor.
- The instance we modified, was a scene with 3 boxes and some slots you could place the boxes into.

## Intent & Design Idea

- **Why?:** 
    - Using the gripper to interact with the objects in the scene, felt like a fun interactive experience.

- **Design Idea:**
    - Claw machine :D

## Demo

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
![](images\slideimages\clawmachine.png){height="550px"}

## Creative Updates

- **New objects, and properties:** We added spheres and rectangles, changed the mass of the objects.

- **Added box:** We added a box to act as the claw machines chute.

- **Expanded Play space:** Increased the space for moving and interacting with the objects by moving the invisible walls outwards.


## Reuse & Extend

- More object types, shapes, meshes, properties
- Make a whole claw machine model.
- Change the gripper to look and act like a claw.
- Sound effects, background, timer, win screen
- Add the claw mechanic of moving the claw from the top along the x-axis, then drops and automatically closes
